subject_line: Application for AI/ML Engineer — Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am a Python Backend Developer building production-ready AI services with FastAPI and RAG systems. I am applying for this role because the JD requires experience with LLMs and vector search, which matches my recent work.

I built an AI-powered resume builder using FastAPI, React, and NLP pipelines to generate ATS keyword-matching scores. I also implemented a client inventory system using Node.js and Prisma ORM to handle authentication and REST APIs.

I bring hands-on experience with Docker containerization and vector search to your team. Let's discuss how I can contribute to your AI projects.
